senses.gloss:
भेदः [भिद् घञ्]
—1 Breaking; splitting, cleaving; hitting (as a mark).
—2 Rending, tearing.
—3 Dividing, separating.
—4 Piercing through, perforation.
—5
——(a) Breach, rupture.
——(b) Breaking open, bursting; V. 2. 7.
—6 Disturbance, interruption.
—7 Division, separation.
—8 A chasm, gap, fissure, cleft.
—9 A hurt, injury, wound.
—10 Difference, distinction; तयोर्न भेदप्रतिपत्तिरस्ति मे Bh. 3. 99;
 अगौरवभेदेन Ku. 6. 12; Bg. 18. 19, 22. रस˚, काल˚ &c.;
 भेदाभेदयोर्भेदो ग्रहीतव्यः ŚB. on MS. 10. 6. 3.
—11 A change, modification; न बुद्धिभेदं जनयेदज्ञानां कर्मसङ्गिनाम् Bg. 3. 26.
—12 Dissension, disunion.
—13 Disclosure, betrayal; as in रहस्यभेदः.
—14 Treachery, treason; भेदाधीनं कृतं शत्रोः सैन्यं शत्रुबलं स्मृतम्
 Śukra. 4. 876.
—15 A kind, variety; भेदाः पद्मशङ्खादयो निधेः Ak.; शिरीषपुष्पभेदः &c.
—16 Dualism.
—17 (In politics) Sowing dissensions in an enemyʼs party and thus winning
 him over to oneʼs side, one of the four Upāyas or means of success against
 an enemy; see उपाय and उपायचतुष्टय; परस्परं तु ये द्विष्टाः
 क्रुद्धभीतावमानिताः । तेषां भेदं प्रयुञ्जीत परमं दर्शयेद् भयम् ॥ Agni P.
—18 Defeat.
—19 (In medicine) Evacuation of the bowels.
—20 Shooting pain (in the limbs).
—21 Paralysis.
—22 Contraction.
—23 A conjunction of the planets.
—24 The hypotenuse of a right-angled triangle.

भेदः + -अभेदौ (dual)
—1 disunion and union, disagreement and agreement.
—2 difference and sameness; भेदाभेदज्ञानम्.

भेदः + -उन्मुख a. on the point of bursting forth or opening; बालाशोकमुपोढरागसुभगं
 भेदोन्मुखं तिष्ठति V. 2. 7.
भेदः + -कर, -कृत् sowing dissensions.
भेदः + -कर, -कृत् sowing dissensions.

भेदः + -दर्शिन्, -दृष्टि, -बुद्धि a. considering the universe as distinct
 from the Supreme Spirit.

भेदः + -दर्शिन्, -दृष्टि, -बुद्धि a. considering the universe as distinct
 from the Supreme Spirit.

भेदः + -दर्शिन्, -दृष्टि, -बुद्धि a. considering the universe as distinct
 from the Supreme Spirit.
भेदः + -प्रत्ययः belief in dualism.
भेदः + -वादिन् m. one who maintains the doctrine of dualism.
भेदः + -विधिः the faculty of discriminating.

भेदः + -सह a.
—1 capable of being divided or separated.
—2 corruptible, seducible.

भेदक a. (-दिका f.) [भिद्-ण्वुल्]
—1 Breaking, splitting, dividing, separating.
—2 Breaking through, piercing.
—3 Destroying, a destroyer; मर्यादाभेदकः Ms. 9. 291.
—4 Distinguishing, discriminating.
—5 Defining.
—6 Evacuating the bowels, purgative.
—7 Diverting (water-courses); स्रोतसां भेदको यश्च तेषां चावरणे रतः Ms. 3. 163.
—8 Seducing (ministers); Ms. 3. 232. Kull.
भेदक + .{@-कः@} An adjective or differentiating attribute.

भेदन a. [भिद्-णिच् ल्यु ल्युट् वा]
—1 Breaking, dividing &c.; नरनागाश्ववृन्दानां भेदनं क्षिप्रकारिणम् Mb. 6. 108. 8.
—2 Loosening (as the feces), purgative.

भेदन + .{@-नम्@}
—1 Splitting,
[]
 breaking, rending.
—2 Dividing, separating.
—3 Distinguishing.
—4 Sowing dissensions, creating discord.
—5 Dissolving, loosening.
—6 Disclosing, betraying.
—7 Disunion, discord.
—8 Asa Foetida.
—9 (In astr.) Passing through a constellation.
—10 Piercing the nostril (of an animal for bridling; नासाच्छेदन);
 गोषु ब्राह्मणसंस्थासु छुरिकायाश्च भेदने Ms. 8. 325.
—11 A purgative.
भेदन + .{@-नः@} A hog.
भेदिका Destruction, annihilation.
भेदित a. Split, broken, divided.

भेदिन् a. [भिद्-णिनि]
—1 Breaking, dividing, distinguishing &c.
—2 One who holds the doctrine of dualism.
भेदिरम्, भेदुरम् A thunderbolt.
भेदिरम्, भेदुरम् A thunderbolt.

भेद्यम् A substantive.
.━{@Comp.@}: भेद्यरोगः, भेद्यलिङ्ग
भेद्यम् + -रोगः a disease treated by incision.
भेद्यम् + -लिङ्ग a. distinguished by the gender.
